name: MarchMallows
description:
About This Game

GET THE MARCHIES HOME


The Marchies are lost and need your help getting home safely.

They are not quite as smart as they are cute, so they need you and your friends to guide them with clever thinking, teamwork and whatever strange tools you can find.

KEEP THEM MOVING


Place objects, tools and contraptions to clear a path and get your Marchies safely through each level.

Block hazards, create shortcuts, trigger mechanisms and figure out how to keep the little idiots moving in the right direction.

Because they won't wait for you.

They will happily march straight into:

  • a meat grinder
  • a bed of spikes
  • a giant hammer
  • a rolling rock
  • or simply off a cliff

THINGS CAN GO VERY WRONG


And when things go wrong, they go really wrong.

A bad plan can turn a dangerous obstacle into an even worse one. One misplaced object can send an entire group of Marchies straight to their doom.

A spring gets them over the wall. A spring set too strong sends them over the wall and into the pit behind it.

There is a no-blood mode. They spray candy instead.

WORK TOGETHER... OR DON'T


Up to four of you. Thirty seconds. One plan.

Everyone places their tools at the same time, and everyone can see who placed what. Then the gate opens and the Marchies start walking, and there is nothing left to do but watch.

Work together, save them all and pat each other on the back for a job well done.

Or watch them all die horribly and start pointing fingers at each other.

Three ways to play

  • Single-player. Take on the levels alone. When it goes wrong, there is nobody to blame but you.
  • Co-op. Up to four players on the same level, one shared plan and one shared clock.
  • PvP. Two teams on the same level, anything from 1v1 to 4v4. Five rounds, one try each. Every Marchie you get home counts, and the team that saves the most wins.

BUILD YOUR OWN


The same blocks, traps and tools we build our levels with are yours too.

Paint the ground, place the traps, set the start and the goal, and pick what the players get to work with. Test it yourself before anyone else does.

Then make something cruel and hand it to your friends.

Play what everyone else built. Some levels are clever, some are just mean, and the Marchies will walk into all of them.

THE SHORT VERSION


MarchMallows is a chaotic puzzle game about teamwork, clever solutions and trying to keep a bunch of adorable idiots alive.

Get your Marchies home safely, take the glory and pat each other on the back.

Or let them die. Then blame your friends.
short_desc: Guide a bunch of adorable, clueless Marchies safely home in this chaotic co-op and PvP puzzle game. Place tools and objects to clear their path, solve deadly obstacles, and keep them alive. Get them all home and pat your friends on the back, or watch them die and start pointing fingers at each other
